workers.name: Workers
workers.title: Workers
workers.disabled: The daemon is off. Set daemon.enabled: true in .forge/config.yml, then start it here.
workers.approval: Review .forge/config.yml and the other files Forge trusts (notes, reviewers, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md), then press Start to approve them for this project.
workers.approvalHint: Approves this project's trusted files as they are now, then starts the daemon
workers.jobModeAbout: Every job without its own choice, now and from its next start. A job's own choice in its panel header overrides it
workers.jobModeAutoWarning: Auto for every job: unattended sessions approve most tool calls without you. Prompts claude still raises wait until someone answers.
workers.billingIgnored: {vars} is set where forge dash started; daemon sessions ignore it and use your Claude login (daemon.auth: subscription).
workers.billingPassed: {vars} is set where forge dash started; daemon sessions bill that account or go through that endpoint (daemon.auth: api-key).

inbox.name: Inbox
inbox.title: Inbox session
inbox.off: The Inbox session runs inside the daemon, which is off. Start it from Workers.

foreman.name: Foreman
foreman.title: Foreman
foreman.about: Supervises the pool: its assistant foremen decide parked gates through assistant sub-agents and hand each job back.
foreman.offBody: Without it, every parked gate (spec approval, escalation, PR feedback) waits for you.
foreman.offHow: To turn it on, set {key} (and {daemonKey}) in {file} by hand. It is locked in Settings and in forge config set, because it lets the daemon decide gates unattended.
foreman.daemonOffHow: The Foreman runs inside the daemon. Set {daemonKey} in {file}, then start the daemon.

conn.title: Connection
conn.connectingText: Waiting for the first reply from forge dash.
conn.liveText: Connected: the dashboard polls forge dash every 2 seconds.
conn.offlineText: The last poll of forge dash failed.
conn.outdatedText: forge dash serves a newer API than this dashboard. Reload the page; if that does not help, restart forge dash after updating the plugin.

inbox.secretRescan: Approve runs the secret scan again. First remove or allowlist the value, or fix what stopped the scan.
inbox.stillBlockedNote: The last approve ran the scan again and it still found a problem.
inbox.budgetStillOver: Still over budget: {keys}. Raise those limits in the note, or approve with no limits to acknowledge them.

decision.queued: Queued: {label}. A job session picks it up and moves the gate.
decision.queuedManual: Queued: {label}. Your orchestrator session picks it up (/forge requests).
decision.applying: Applying: {label}. A job session is moving the gate.

shelf.heading: Shelved
shelf.about: Set aside by a person: nothing runs on these until you decide, and they don't count as waiting on you.
shelf.note: Note for the agents (sent with Approve and Rework; Rework needs one)

confirmClose.one: Close {count} job? It is cancelled and its PR stays as it is.
confirmClose.other: Close {count} jobs? They are cancelled and their PRs stay as they are.

milestoneDraft.note: Note for the drafter (what to change), or why you approve or reject
milestoneDraft.filingHint: Retry filing picks up where it stopped; nothing filed is filed twice.

gate.foremanTitle: The foreman decides this gate through an assistant sub-agent
gate.humanTitle: This gate stays with a human: a reserved topic, or a gate the foreman does not decide
gate.leftForHumanTitle: The Foreman looked at this gate and left it for a person

handoff.reserved: Foreman left this for a human (reserved): {reason}
handoff.escalated: Foreman left this for a human (escalated): {reason}
handoff.refused: Foreman left this for a human (decision refused): {reason}

budget.unlimited: this month · no monthly cap, spend is unlimited
budget.dayLabel: Today's spend against the daily cap
budget.noHeldJobs: No job is parked yet; new work waits until the cap allows it.
budget.ackHelp: Grants one more period of budget and releases the held jobs whose own budget is fine.
budget.cardPointer: Held by the repo budget: acknowledge it in Repo budget above, or cancel the job.
